mapper.select: SELECT LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, MEMBER_ID as memberId, LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, SPECIALTY, INTRO, CAREER, OFFICE_NAME as officeName, OFFICE_ADDR as officeAddr, CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, AVG_RATING as avgRating, REVIEW_CNT as reviewCnt, APPROVE_STATUS as approveStatus, TO_CHAR(APPROVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as approvedAt, APPROVED_BY as approvedBy, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as createdAt, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as updatedAt FROM TB_LAWYER ORDER BY CASE WHEN APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, MEMBER_ID as memberId, LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, SPECIALTY, INTRO, CAREER, OFFICE_NAME as officeName, OFFICE_ADDR as officeAddr, CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, AVG_RATING as avgRating, REVIEW_CNT as reviewCnt, APPROVE_STATUS as approveStatus, TO_CHAR(APPROVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as approvedAt, APPROVED_BY as approvedBy, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as createdAt, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as updatedAt FROM TB_LAWYER WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}

SELECT LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, MEMBER_ID as memberId, LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, SPECIALTY, OFFICE_NAME as officeName, CONSULT_FEE as consultFee FROM TB_LAWYER WHERE SPECIALTY LIKE '%' || #{specialty} || '%' AND APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY AVG_RATING DESC
